s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of systemic illness with cytopenias, splenomegaly, and skin lesions, complicated by febrile neutropenia and focal infection
salient_findings: Pancytopenia with lymphoblasts on peripheral-blood smear
Splenomegaly
Eczematous plaques on the chest and proximal right arm
Febrile neutropenia with positive blood cultures
Focal cystic necrotic lesion between the teres minor and teres major muscles
key_facts: Eczematous plaques on the chest and proximal right arm
Splenomegaly 6 cm below the costal margin
Flow cytometry positive for TdT, CD34, CD19, CD10, CD22, and HLA-DR
Coagulase-negative Staphylococcus species in blood cultures
Enterococcus species in repeat blood cultures
Severe pain in the right arm radiating to the shoulder
Focal cystic necrotic lesion between the teres minor and teres major muscles on MRI

shortlist.label: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Confirmed by bone marrow evaluation and flow cytometry

shortlist.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Considered due to presence of cytopenias, splenomegaly, and lymphoblasts on peripheral-blood smear

shortlist.label: Histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible due to presence of skin lesions and splenomegaly

shortlist.label: Splenomegaly with Myelofibrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Considered due to presence of splenomegaly and cytopenias

shortlist.label: Myeloproliferative Neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: Possible due to presence of splenomegaly and cytopenias

raw.rationale: The presence of lymphoblasts on the peripheral-blood smear and flow cytometry positive for TdT, CD34, CD19, CD10, CD22, and HLA-DR are diagnostic of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia

rejected.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
rejected.why: The flow cytometry results do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Histiocytosis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of histiocyte proliferation or infiltration

rejected.label: Splenomegaly with Myelofibrosis
rejected.why: The bone marrow evaluation confirmed Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia, not myelofibrosis

rejected.label: Myeloproliferative Neoplasm
rejected.why: The presence of lymphoblasts and specific flow cytometry markers are not consistent with this diagnosis
